description: Defines a template class 'UniqueVector' and related hash set structures for managing unique collections of items with fast lookup, insertion, and removal, optimized for GN's usage.

classes.name: UniqueVector
classes.description: A template class implementing an ordered set with fast lookup and insertion, avoiding duplicates.

classes.name: UniqueVectorHashSet
classes.description: A hash set class used internally by UniqueVector for managing item uniqueness.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Adds an item to the vector if it does not already exist.

methods.name: emplace_back
methods.description: Constructs and adds an item in-place if it does not already exist.

methods.name: PushBackWithIndex
methods.description: Adds an item and returns a pair indicating if insertion occurred and the item's index.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if an item exists in the vector.

methods.name: IndexOf
methods.description: Returns the index of a given item.
